# Huruy Kidanemariam, Senior UX Designer & Builder

> Portfolio of Huruy Kidanemariam, a Senior UX Designer and Builder in Los Angeles crafting accessible, human-centered products for enterprise SaaS, compliance, AI, and social impact, with 8+ years of experience.

## Pages

- [Home](https://huruy.tech/): Current role, four case studies, availability for senior UX roles, and contact.
- [Fintech UX design](https://huruy.tech/fintech-ux-designer): Senior UX Designer at Capital Group, with payroll compliance and HR case studies from Asure Software.
- [About](https://huruy.tech/about): Background, experience, and how Huruy works (design reviews, disagreement with engineering, mentoring).
- [Resume](https://huruy.tech/resume): Work history and downloadable resume.
- [Contact](https://huruy.tech/contact): Get in touch about senior UX roles and product design work.
- [Book](https://huruy.tech/book): The Oracle of San Quentin, Huruy's unofficial biography of Curtis "Wall Street" Carroll, with paperback and Kindle availability.
- [App Store launch](https://huruy.tech/appstore): Huruy's fixed-price service that turns Lovable and other AI-built web apps into native iOS apps approved on the App Store, with the Beles launch as a worked example.
- [App Store guides](https://huruy.tech/guides): Plain-language guides for founders getting Lovable, Bolt, Replit, v0 and Cursor apps onto the App Store, including the rejections Apple sends most and how to fix them.

## Case Studies

- [Asure Compliance Engine](https://huruy.tech/project/asure-compliance): Onsite redesign of an enterprise payroll compliance engine serving 9,000+ tax agencies: the entity model, revision state machine and configuration patterns, with the detailed narrative available by request.
- [OneAsure Portal](https://huruy.tech/project/oneasure-portal): Consolidating four enterprise HR portals (time, benefits, payroll, HR) into one product.
- [Doula Care Portal](https://huruy.tech/project/doula-care-portal): HIPAA-compliant doula care records and Medi-Cal billing (visit caps, CMS-1500 claims, role-based access) for a Bay Area birth-justice nonprofit; 56 accounts across 5 organizations as of September 2026.
- [EBT Finder](https://huruy.tech/project/ebtfinder): Review-first store locator for SNAP/EBT households, researched, designed, built, and shipped solo to the App Store.
- [Beles](https://huruy.tech/project/beles): Dating and community app concept for the Tigrayan diaspora, built around traditional matchmaking.
